caption.text: CaptainGood morning, passengers. This is your captain. We are on schedule, on course, and on speaking terms with the weather.

hint.text: Welcome to Marineris. Leave by the starboard gangway: the boarding hall is behind the promenade.

caption.text: StewardWelcome to Mars. Follow the amber lights to the big Arrivals sign. If you reach a fuel tank, you have taken tourism too far.

caption.text: PilotWelcome aboard the Kestrel. Flight time is about a minute. We have never needed more.
PilotWe are climbing out of the port now. Please keep your hands inside the ship and your regrets inside yourselves.
PilotControl says a solar storm is building. The Sun has not apologised.
PilotComms just died. So did guidance. Everything is down, and so soon we will be. Brace for impact.

hint.text: Impact. Hold on, the cabin is going dark.

caption.text: ShipEmergency power engaged. Please remain calm. Calm is an option.
